title: Not Out Of The Woods Yet
speaker: Figuring Out Money host

macro_themes.view: Staples' 12-month outperformance vs the S&P is the highest since 2022-23; crossing 5% has coincided with rough markets, a warning but not actionable.
Back above the gamma flip line (lower volatility) with bullish seasonality, but declining 10/20-day moving averages on the Nasdaq Composite mean patience.
10-year yield tracking 2018 closely; if oil leads, yields could push higher into the midterms, though he doubts a repeat of 2018's unravel.
